AlternateTargets: after a long while, he said
Senses.Explanation: Literally, 'after a good while, said.' This fixed narrative formula occurs 2,037 times in 79 allowed texts. It marks an interval before quoted speech in dialogues and assembly addresses. In the Five Lamps Complete Collection, Tianyi Yihuai asks, 'Then what is it?' and after a while says, 'Do you understand? Take care!' (且作麼生即是？良久曰：還會麼？珍重). In a Five Lamps Rigorous Continuation address, the speaker ascends the hall, waits, says, 'Assembly, look, look,' and descends (上堂，良久曰：大眾看看。便下座). Another record asks where Maitreya is and, after a while, answers, 'When walking at night do not tread on white; if it is not water, it is stone' (且道彌勒在甚麼處？良久曰：夜行莫踏白，不是水便是石). The Continued Transmission of the Lamp supplies both extended statements and short closings after the formula: 'a drop of spring rain is slick as oil' (春雨一滴滑如油) and 'fine food does not suit a full person,' followed by descent from the seat (美食不中飽人喫。便下座). The punctuation varies by edition, but the sequence remains interval, speech verb, and quotation.
Senses.Note: The close variant 'after a while, said' with the alternate speech graph (良久云) occurs 1,403 times in 169 texts. 'Silently for a long while' (默然良久) occurs 45 times in 32 texts, while three records have 'after a while, descended from the seat' (良久下座) without the speech verb. Those forms confirm the components but are not merged into the headword count. No self-definition formula is applicable to this narrative connector.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂良久曰。夫行脚禪流直須著忖。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Shexian Guisheng section. Shexian Guisheng is the exact speaker: in his own hall address he remains silent for a long time and then tells travelling Chan students that they must take thought and possess the eye of study.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久曰。春雨一滴滑如油。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 續傳燈錄, Guyin Yuncong section. Guyin Yuncong is the exact speaker: after asking for a phrase that receives spring rain's beneficence, he remains silent for a long time and says that one drop of spring rain is slick as oil.

Occurrences.Kwic: 良久曰。美食不中飽人喫。便下座。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Continued Transmission of the Lamp (續傳燈錄), Jiufeng Qin entry. Jiufeng Qin is the exact hall speaker who pauses, says that fine food does not suit a person who is already full, and descends from the seat; Zhimen Guangzuo is the lineage-header teacher, not this speaker.

Occurrences.Kwic: 且作麼生即是？良久曰：還會麼？珍重！
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷): complete-case exact-turn review identifies Tianyi Yihuai as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂，良久曰：大眾看看。便下座。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈嚴統(第10卷-第25卷). Record of the Transmission of the Lamp in the Jingde Era (景德傳燈錄), Wuyun Zhifeng section. Wuyun Zhifeng is the exact actor and speaker: he mounts the hall, remains silent for a long while, tells the assembly to look, and immediately leaves the seat.
